selected.note: Enumerates clients (companies, D-034).
Client identity, address, EIN (provider-masked, D-024); PEO settings go to extensions.
Client code tables: pay codes, deduction codes, locations and pay groups (step 2); status, type, job and org code labels (step 3, D-064).
Pay group frequency (payPeriod, documented letters, D-041 amendment). The demo sends the singular key (D-062).
Enumerates employees; the default includes terminated employees on the 3 sampled clients.
All 14 options; the DirectDeposit block is the deposit source (D-046).
Position, pay, leave, status and termination history. The demo sends the singular key (D-062).
Compensation history; sentinel effective dates (D-025).
Status history with hire, original hire and seniority dates.
Position rates; empty for 6 of 6 sampled.
PTO balances (D-027): 4 registers in 2 sampled employees; no balance field (balance not_provided).
Related people (dependents and beneficiaries): 2 dependents for 1 of the 2 sampled employees, none for the other.
Per pay code rate overrides; empty for 2 of 2 sampled.
Documented employee deduction setup (D-048).
One-time or temporary deductions; empty for 6 of 6 sampled.
Empty for 6 of 6 sampled.
404 'no arrears' for 5 of 6 sampled (D-021).
403 for the demo user (6 of 6, D-021); presence comes from checkForGarnishments (D-048).
Garnishment presence flags (D-048).
Retirement loan setups (3 loans, 1 employee).
Employee plan enrollments (D-049).
Billing, premium and contribution rates for one plan; kept raw on the enrollment (billing amounts, period not stated; the per-pay amount is getDeductions amount, D-084).
Enumerates batches (D-022).
Batch detail with pay periods per pay group (D-050).
Vouchers per batch, paged (D-022). The demo sends the singular key (D-062).

excluded.reason: One pay group's current period state (next pay date, period dates, payroll number) and billing address (2 calls). Pay groups come from getClientCodes and their frequency from getPayrollSchedule; a pay group named only by batch lists, vouchers or employees is added from its id, reference_only (D-097).
One pay code's calculation setup (one call per code; 1 call). getClientCodes carries the classification fields (payClass, compensationType, rateClass, payReason) and W-2 box for every code.

One deduction code's setup (one call per code; 3 calls). getClientCodes carries the type, calculation method, W-2 fields and the same classification flags (client401k, clientSection125, clientHSA, ...); default limits are setup configuration.
SSNs are provider-masked for this API user (369 of 369, D-024); getEmployee carries the same masked field.
Plans active on one date, a filtered view of getBenefitPlans, which returns every plan with its status.
PTO transaction ledger, out of scope (D-027); balances come from getPaidTimeOff.
PTO transaction ledger by date, out of scope (D-027).
Retirement register summary; 404 'no register found' for 2 of 2 sampled. Retirement deductions and employer amounts come from deduction setups and vouchers (D-051).
Garnishment payment history (404 none for 2 of 2 sampled); amounts taken are voucher deduction lines.
Payments scheduled for a future batch (404 for 2 of 2 sampled): input to a payroll, not its result.
Pre-calculated payments to be paid in a batch (bonuses, commissions, reimbursements): input to a payroll; the results are voucher lines.
Statuses only; the batch list and getBatchInfo carry the status.
Employee ids paid in a batch; the batch's vouchers carry them.
Summary of completed batches; batches and vouchers are read in full.
Voucher-by-voucher summary for an employee; the vouchers are read in full.
Period-to-date accumulators: not listed in the brief and summed from vouchers (same treatment as isolved to-date fields, D-051).
Bulk form of the year-to-date accumulators (see getYearToDateValues). Not called.
401(k) amounts per voucher for a date range; the same vouchers are read in full (deduction lines, retirement block). Not compared with vouchers in discovery.
Date-range voucher list; payroll is enumerated by batch because this route's total looked like the page size (D-022).
Per-employee list of the same vouchers; batch enumeration returns them (D-022).
One voucher by id; batch enumeration returns the same model. A reversal links to its original by canonical id without fetching it (section 8.1).
Manual checks before posting; once posted they are vouchers (route description). Not called.
Asynchronous list of retirement adjustment voucher ids; adjustment vouchers are in the batch enumeration. Not called.
Standard hours per pay group and period (configuration); employee standard hours come from getEmployee. Not called.
PTO balances written by an external system; PrismHR's own balances come from getPaidTimeOff. Not called.
One payroll schedule by schedule code (calendar setup); pay groups and schedules come from clientMaster getPayrollSchedule. Not called.
Repeats getDeductions: its records equal the type V records of getDeductions (8 of 8 records in 6 employees, every field equal). One source per fact (D-073, D-081).

Voluntary ACH deduction transfers to DED1 to DED3 accounts (custom feature VOLUNTARYDEDACH): not net pay deposits, and the deductions themselves come from getDeductions and voucher lines. Empty for 6 of 6 sampled (D-081).

Same EmployeeEvent model as the getEmployee employeeEvents block, which is classified there (sensitive extension); both empty in the samples (4 responses, 0 events). One source per fact (D-073, D-079).

Form I-9 detail (documents, numbers, dates). Not called: work authorization comes from getEmployee (nonResAlien; formI9Filed as i9_on_file, D-078, D-079), and I-9 document details have no typed home, so they would only feed the sensitive extension (D-071).

Current and possible employers within a client (PEO entity assignment); not called. Tax entities come from the client master (D-034, step 2), and the employee's employer ids are kept from getEmployee person.employerIds in provider_extensions.
Needs a subscription event id; pending future changes, not current records.
Detail of one worksite location (one call per location; masks bank PII by default). Not called: work locations, with their addresses, come from getClientCodes locationCode (step 2).
Version 2 of getClientLocationDetails (see that entry).
Plans offered by a client (catalog); employee enrollments come from getBenefitPlans. Not called.
Coverage settings of STD and LTD plan offers (plan setup). Not called.
Client pay grade table; the canonical model has no pay grade field. Not called.
Used by the Phase 8 write path before a create (D-043 rule 1), not by normalization.
Sign-in, security, system settings, event subscriptions and document storage: platform functions, not employer, employee or payroll records.
Applicants, onboarding tasks, approvals and staffing placements: people who are not employees yet, or HR workflow.
What the PEO bills the client and how it posts to the general ledger: PEO accounting, not employee pay.
Tax rate tables, tax authorities and geo codes: configuration for calculating tax. Tax lines come from vouchers; getTaxAuthorities describes local tax authorities for a state, not a tax type (D-056).
Time entry, time-off requests and PTO plan setup: not one of the four data types. PTO balances come from getPaidTimeOff (D-027).
Tax and ACA forms, their years and reporting status: documents and filings, not structured employee or pay records.
E-Verify and OSHA records: compliance, not one of the four data types (I-9 is listed separately).
Plan setup, rates, rules, eligibility, enrollment workflow, life events, COBRA and FSA claims. Employee enrollments (plan, status, coverage, premiums) come from getBenefitPlans (D-049).

Approval, initialization, notes, processing schedules, control options, indexes and rendered stubs: how a payroll is run, not its results. Runs and vouchers come from the batch list and vouchers (D-022).
PEO client contacts, ownership, messages, document expirations, labor allocation and union setup, pay day rules: client administration, not employee or payroll records.

Descriptions of client codes (org units, positions, EEO, events, skills, custom fields). Employee records carry the codes; the model has company tables only for tax entities, locations, pay groups, deduction and earning codes. Not called.

Employee lists filtered by entity, pay group, routing number or garnishment docket, valid termination dates, and pending approvals: indexes over records the selected routes return, or helpers for writes.
